title: Hiring Signals + Verified Contacts
description: Check public ATS boards for open roles in the functions you track. One company per row. Boards are public-by-design (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby).

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Companies to check. Each row needs a display name and a domain used to derive the ATS board token.

name.title: Company name
name.description: Display name, also used as a board-token candidate.

domain.title: Domain
domain.description: Company hostname, such as stripe.com. www is ignored.

trackedFunctions.title: Tracked functions
trackedFunctions.description: Role functions to count toward a hiring signal. Matching is keyword-based on the job title. Allowed values: sales, engineering, marketing, product, design, data, finance, people, operations, support, legal.

signalThreshold.title: Signal threshold
signalThreshold.description: Minimum number of open roles that match a tracked function before the company counts as a hiring signal. Contact lookup (later) only runs when this is met.
